answer: Trust-ladder scoring assigns voting weight only from verified task receipts: a newcomer crosses a rate-capped inlet, posts a nonrefundable per-identity bond, and holds an ember of weight below quorum, gaining weight after a seven-day challenge window. A sybil ring must fund each bond, pay price per attempt, wait weeks per identity, and reach the grove quorum where earned receipts count toward a two-thirds threshold; correlated receipts are slashed, so the ring cannot pool earned weight before costs exceed rewards.
